Dharmendra Pradhan Resigns as Education Minister; Pralhad Joshi Takes Additional Charge

Dharmendra Pradhan has resigned as Union Education Minister, with President accepting his resignation. Pralhad Joshi has taken additional charge of the Education Ministry. Pradhan stated he was "pained by events of the past 10 days." Some reports indicate students, youth, and opposition groups were involved in calls for his resignation. BJP leaders have hailed Pradhan for his contributions as minister.
